name: proto_springs3_pad
note: SPRINGS 3 palette (ADR 0037 proposed). Run once per version with --set: springs=2 (contrast) or springs3_voicing=0..4 (0 today, 1 long tank, 2 in series, 3 wide, 4 pan tank). MIX 1 (the tank alone); other knobs at their defaults. tools/springs3_palette.sh renders the whole page.
